rationale: EZPW has gapped down roughly 11% from prior close with no news catalyst identified, creating an ambiguous setup — the stock is sitting at 26% of today's range with price consolidating tightly near $29.60, but the wide bid-ask spread (60.8 bps) and lack of directional momentum in the last 5 candles make it difficult to establish a reliable edge.
